desc: Identify the exact reduction to a maximum connected subset of original-degree >= 4 vertices with internal degree <= 4, with alkane size 3k + 2.

Implement the complete core-reduction solution in Python with no placeholder text: read stdin, print stdout, compute original degrees, build the high-degree forest, process components iteratively in postorder, maintain top-4 child down values in O(1) per edge, compute down and best as specified, and output 3*k+2 or -1.
Verify the implementation against the public samples; all samples passed, so no fallback approach is needed.
